offline_restore.name: offline_restore
offline_restore.description: Set offline restore mode for MongoDB Enterprise Edition. Gen2: Accepted but ignored. Offline restore requires backup_id support which is not yet implemented for Gen2 instances.

plan.name: plan
plan.description: The plan type of the Database instance

point_in_time_recovery_deployment_id.name: point_in_time_recovery_deployment_id
point_in_time_recovery_deployment_id.description: The CRN of source instance. Gen2: Plan fails if set. Point-in-time recovery is not yet implemented for Gen2 instances.

point_in_time_recovery_time.name: point_in_time_recovery_time
point_in_time_recovery_time.description: The point in time recovery time stamp of the deployed instance. Gen2: Plan fails if set. Point-in-time recovery is not yet implemented for Gen2 instances.

remote_leader_id.name: remote_leader_id
remote_leader_id.description: The CRN of leader database. Gen2: Plan fails if set. Read-only replica creation and promotion are not supported for Gen2 instances.

resource_controller_url.description: The URL of the IBM Cloud dashboard that can be used to explore and view details about the resource

resource_group_id.name: resource_group_id
resource_group_id.description: The id of the resource group in which the Database instance is present

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The resource group name in which resource is provisioned

service.name: service
service.description: The name of the Cloud Internet database service

service_endpoints.name: service_endpoints
service_endpoints.description: Types of the service endpoints. Possible values are 'public', 'private', 'public-and-private'. Required for Classic plans. Gen2: Optional; must be 'private' if set. Gen2 instances only support private endpoints and default to 'private'. Plan fails if set to 'public' or 'public-and-private'.

skip_initial_backup.name: skip_initial_backup
skip_initial_backup.description: Option to skip the initial backup when promoting a read-only replica. Skipping the initial backup means that your replica becomes available more quickly, but there is no immediate backup available. Gen2: Accepted but ignored (Classic-only feature for read replica promotion).

users.name: users
users.description: Database users. Gen2: Plan fails if set. Use the ibm_resource_key resource to create service credentials for Gen2 instances.

role.name: role
role.description: User role. Only available for ops_manager user type and Redis 6.0 and above.

version.name: version
version.description: The database version to provision if specified or the database version to upgrade to. Classic: This field can be updated to perform an in-place upgrade without forcing the creation of a new resource. Gen2: Can be set at creation only. Updates fail with error. In-place version upgrades are not supported for Gen2 plans.

version_upgrade_skip_backup.name: version_upgrade_skip_backup
version_upgrade_skip_backup.description: Option to skip the backup when upgrading version. Only applicable to databases that do not support PITR. Skipping the backup means that your deployment becomes available more quickly, but there is no immediate backup available. This is not recommended as it could result in data loss. Gen2: Accepted but ignored (Classic-only feature for version upgrades).
